append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-10 (slice 1, transport and model, best-practice call): lib/editor-crdt/awareness.ts gains a pure peer book (hear, leave, prune on a 20 s TTL, 50-peer cap) and the provider takes an optional `presence` option: each tab broadcasts its own {userId, name, color, selectedNid} on a separate `presence` event on the same private channel (on join, on a 6 s heartbeat, on every selection change, and a `leave` on disconnect), hears the others, and never writes any of it to the document. Tests cover two tabs seeing each other, a selection following, goodbye, TTL, the peer cap, and the document bytes unchanged by presence. Not done: the faces in the top bar and the on-canvas selection outlines (a component in components/builder/presence, wired in the shell), and the probe scripts/probes/builder/BLD-401.mjs that switches this row to cmd. Row stays blocked on those two, not on anything external.
